name: Collin Creek Shopping Center
summary: Collin Creek Shopping Center is a well-positioned retail destination at North Central Expressway and 15th Street in Plano, Texas, serving over 325,000 residents within five miles. The center offers convenient access to retail and services in one of the Dallas-Fort Worth area's most affluent and rapidly growing communities.
demographics: Collin Creek Shopping Center serves the affluent Plano market with over 325,000 residents within five miles, characterized by upper-middle-class families and professionals. The trade area features high household incomes, well-educated demographics, and a mix of young families and established professionals typical of the North Dallas suburbs. Primary shoppers include convenience-oriented consumers seeking everyday retail and services, with strong representation from the Asian-American and diverse professional communities that define modern Plano.
description: Collin Creek Shopping Center is strategically positioned at the southwest corner of North Central Expressway (US 75) and 15th Street in Plano, Texas, serving as a vital retail hub in one of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex's most dynamic markets. Managed by FRPLTD, this shopping center benefits from exceptional visibility and access along one of North Texas's primary transportation corridors, drawing from a robust trade area of over 325,000 residents within a five-mile radius. The center has evolved to meet the changing needs of Plano's affluent and diverse community, offering a mix of retail, service, and dining options that cater to the daily needs of local families and professionals. With convenient access from the North Central Expressway, the property serves as a community gathering place in a city known for its strong economy, excellent schools, and high quality of life. The shopping center's location in Plano positions it within one of the fastest-growing and most prosperous markets in Texas, benefiting from the area's continued residential and commercial development.
